question:
Choose the one which can be substituted for the given sentence.

One who studies the evolution of mankind
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Anthropologist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anthropologist"** refers to a person who studies the origin, development, and evolution of mankind, including physical, social, and cultural aspects. (मानवशास्त्री)

 
 
• **Example:** The anthropologist spent years studying the tribal culture of the Amazon rainforest.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word for someone who studies the evolution of mankind is **Anthropologist**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Archaeologist** (पुरातत्त्ववेत्ता): A person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and analysis of physical remains.

 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologist discovered a Roman coin at the excavation site.
 
 
 
• **Sociologist** (समाजशास्त्री): A person who studies the development, structure, and functioning of human society.
 
 
• **Example:** The sociologist conducted a survey to understand the behavior of urban communities.
 
 
 
• **Philologist** (भाषाशास्त्री): A person who studies language in written historical sources; a linguist.
 
 
• **Example:** The philologist analyzed ancient manuscripts to learn about extinct languages.
